title: Scope Inclusions Matrix for Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Project Classes
content:
# Scope Inclusions Matrix

What each class of Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects includes in the contract value is fixed by the matrix below. An item marked yes is performed within the contract value; an item marked no is outside the class's scope.

| Inclusion | Equipment Replacement Order | Planned Replacement Program | Controls Retrofit Project | Energy Retrofit Project | Turnkey Mechanical Upgrade Project | Design-Build Infrastructure Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Contractor pulls the mechanical permits | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Permit fees passed through at cost | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Contractor coordinates authority inspections | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Crane and rigging included | no | yes | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Removal and disposal of the old equipment | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Refrigerant recovery and documentation | yes | yes | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Factory start-up and commissioning | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Air and water balancing | no | no | no | yes | yes | yes |
| As-built drawings delivered at closeout | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Full-time site supervisor assigned | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## Reading across the classes

Permit handling, permit fee pass-through, inspection coordination, disposal of the old equipment and factory start-up are included in every class. Crane and rigging are outside the Equipment Replacement Order and the Controls Retrofit Project. Refrigerant recovery is outside the Controls Retrofit Project alone, that class replacing controls rather than refrigerant-bearing equipment. Air and water balancing is included from the Energy Retrofit Project upward. As-built drawings and a full-time site supervisor are included from the Controls Retrofit Project upward.

## Basis Q&A

**Is crane and rigging within the contract value of a Controls Retrofit Project?** No. The matrix shows crane and rigging as not included for that class.

**Does a Planned Replacement Program deliver as-built drawings at closeout?** No; as-built drawings are included only from the Controls Retrofit Project upward.
